name: OpenAI image edits accept a transparent PNG markup
title: OpenAI image edits accept a transparent PNG markup
summary: OpenAI's image-edit docs add a markup option that lays a transparent PNG over an image to guide the edit, and the description says it supports GPT Image 2.5 and 2.6. GPT Image 2.6 is named there and is not in the API model list, which still stops at GPT Image 2.5.
